concerns.text: FR-005 mandates a 'linear mixed-model' (LMM) with random effects. Task T016 implements a 'Fixed-Effects GLS' model, explicitly rejecting the LMM approach. There is no task to implement the required LMM (e.g., using `lme4` as per Plan Phase 6), leaving the core statistical requirement unmet.

FR-003 requires a sensitivity sweep reporting 'downstream β₁ estimates' for FDR thresholds {0.01, 0.05, 0.10}. Current tasks (T007-T007b3) only extract top CREs and compute overlaps. No task exists to re-run the statistical model (LMM/GLS) on the 0.01 and 0.10 peak sets to generate the required β₁ estimates for the sweep report.

FR-014 requires validating distal CREs using 'motif overlap OR Hi-C contact frequency'. Tasks T013a (motif) and T013a2 (Hi-C) produce separate flags, but T013c logic ('if motif_validated... else if hic_validated... else exclude') implies a sequential or exclusive check that may not correctly implement the inclusive 'OR' logic required to retain CREs valid by either method.

FR-017 requires comparing the 'full set' vs the 'filtered set (post-FR-014)' to quantify selection bias. Task T026 describes comparing 'full set (post-FR-014)' against 'filtered set (post-VIF)', which compares two different filtering stages rather than the required unfiltered vs. filtered comparison.

SC-005 requires reporting the 'percentage of summit matches' in the final output. Task T032 computes this metric, but there is no explicit task to integrate this specific metric into the `Statistical_summary.pdf` (T028) as a distinct table or plot, risking omission from the final deliverable.

Task T013a description states it outputs `hic_matrix_10kb.cool`, but this file is the output of T042. This is a stale/incorrect description referencing an output file that belongs to a different task, creating confusion about data provenance.
